'''Docking Bay 99''' was located in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Located a block north of [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]] near [[Tan-Tek's Roast-Basted Bantha Ribs]], Docking Bay 99 was owned by the [[Tatooine Teamsters Union]]. "Old 99," as it was locally known, was built at the same time as Docking Bay 94.
